build_ActionNetwork: build a multi-layer linear action network with configurable hidden size and layer count
build_FilmActionNetwork: build a FiLM action network that applies learned beta and gamma to modulate image features
build_SimpleNetWithAction: build a simple convolutional network with action-conditioned feature fusion for PHYRE tasks
build_ResNet18FilmAction: build a ResNet-18 based network with FiLM action fusion at configurable stages
test_SimpleNetWithAction_ce_loss: test the SimpleNetWithAction ce_loss method to compute binary cross entropy with logits
